name: – Pasquale Tridico – § 17 – Am 2
title: SECOND REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section II – European Council and Council
part_text: 17. Stresses that the current situation must be resolved through improved interinstitutional cooperation within the existing treaty framework; rejects any amendment to the Treaties or any expansion of Parliament’s powers on the grounds of the discharge procedure; calls on the Council to provide Parliament, in full and in a timely manner, with the information necessary for effective budgetary oversight;
